Name: Stardew News - New TV Channel
Author: yuhkall
Description:
Stardew News is a TV channel which shows random events that happens inside the Stardew Region, from places like Stardew Cliffs and Stardew Mountains. The places are outside of Stardew Valley. Stardew News is shown on the TV everyday. This doesn't change the gameplay at all, and all the lines are just possible lines you may see on the news in real life.

Some lines reference events that are in game, events that aren't in the game, events in real life, natural disasters (no violence), the NPC's in Stardew Valley (though it never mentions names, only hints towards who the character could be), pop-culture references and jokes. This mod is basically something that you would look at every once in a while when you look at the TV.

I'm definitely going to add more lines of dialogue over time. I'm also going to look over some of the more awkward lines and rewrite them/fix the grammar when I have the time to.

This may not be compatible with other mods that add TV channels . I will test other mods that use the same framework and ensure that none of them will clash or cause errors. I know that the mod looks a little rough around the edges but it will definitely be improved in the future.
